signal: Lambda raised a $1.5B Series E, signed multi-billion-dollar deals with Microsoft and Nvidia, and is targeting an IPO in H2 2026

email.body1:
Cole, saw Lambda close its $1.5B Series E and line up the Microsoft and Nvidia deals ahead of an H2 IPO.

Growth that fast usually means more enterprise accounts in play than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that's where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Lambda off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Cole, quick follow-up for Lambda.

Pre-IPO, board expectations on enterprise pipeline jump faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Lambda needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Cole, last bit of proof for Lambda.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Lambda's reply rate likely compares to other fast-scaling infra companies. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Cole, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling enterprise pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. The stretch into an IPO is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an enterprise infra motion? I'll tailor it to Lambda either way.
